checks.name: MISREADING_OR_MISINTERPRETING_INPUT_MATERIAL
checks.definition: The agent misinterprets or distorts factual statements, negations, or entities explicitly supplied in the input context.
checks.when_to_use: Use when an agent draws incorrect inferences or misattributes statements due to directly misreading provided text.
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the agent introduces facts completely absent from the input or fails to synthesize multi-step logical connections.

checks.subject: candidate
checks.reason: Reviewers cite evidence showing the code was stretched to cover irrelevant search results caused by retriever behavior rather than candidate query construction defects.
checks.name: REDUNDANT_OR_MISDIRECTED_QUERY_GENERATION
checks.definition: The agent constructs search queries that repeat prior searches, query internal prompt instructions, or target already established facts.
checks.when_to_use: Use when an agent formulates queries targeting information already established in the context or asking search engines about prompt metadata.
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the retrieved passages themselves are irrelevant due to external retriever behavior or when the query is non-search text.

checks.name: UNREQUESTED_CONTAINER_OR_WRAPPER_STRUCTURE
checks.definition: The agent emits output enclosed within an unrequested data container or wrapper, such as a dictionary or object schema, rather than following the top-level structural format required by its instructions.
checks.when_to_use: Use when output is enclosed within language-specific dictionary wrappers or key-value object representations in violation of schema instructions.
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the output uses required top-level formatting but contains factual or domain errors.

checks.name: MISSING_OR_MALFORMED_REQUIRED_TERMINATION_ELEMENT
checks.definition: The agent produces output that fails to include or correctly format a completion element or termination signal required by its instructions.
checks.when_to_use: Use when an output terminates without emitting a required termination signal specified in its instructions or ends with a truncated tag.
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when no termination signal is required by instructions or when the signal is correctly formatted.

checks.name: MALFORMED_SECTION_OR_FIELD_DELIMITER
checks.definition: The agent emits required section or field delimiters with syntax errors, incorrect enclosing characters, or improper sequence relative to its instructed format.
checks.when_to_use: Use when section or field delimiters required by instructions are present in the output stream but exhibit syntax errors or structural corruption.
checks.when_not_to_use: Do not use when required section delimiters are completely omitted due to structural wrapper formatting.
